title: Explicit object parameters
summary: A C++23 `this` parameter shows in the label and takes the first argument's mark
prose:
The object a member is called on is not an argument, yet the label lists
`this Shape &self` and marks it while the cursor is on the argument for `dx`.

value.wrong: the object parameter is listed and marked, while the cursor is on the argument for dx (clangd#2284)

signatures: move(⟦this Shape &self⟧, int dx, int dy) -> void
